about: Expectations for engine/regression/aukerman.manifest.json (the Aukerman Park example, 42 photos, CC0). Limits are regression bounds around values measured on WebSfM 0.8.0 (61022796) in headless Chrome 157 on macOS, 8 cores, Apple GPU (WebGPU), 2026-11-17; they are not accuracy claims. positionCheck compares the solved camera centres with the photos' own consumer GPS (EXIF), an independent but metre-level reference.
